h1: Custom Cotton Poly Vests for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Cotton Poly Vests | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly vests for your team. Durable, breathable, and perfect for branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cotton poly vests combine the softness of cotton with the durability of polyester, making them a practical choice for outdoor work or events. The blend resists wrinkles and shrinks less than pure cotton, so your logo stays crisp wash after wash. Safety managers often choose these vests for their breathability, while marketing directors appreciate the smooth surface for screen printing or embroidery. Whether you need hi-vis accents or a classic uniform look, cotton poly vests deliver comfort and longevity for bulk orders.
heroAltText: Custom cotton poly vests with embroidered logos on a rack, showing breathable fabric and professional appearance.
